verdicts.evidence: Hole, measured 2026-11-04: a false green. On `notjunit` the pristine build refuses the seal (exit 1, "sealed evidence changed: code/reports/junit.xml ... no longer parses as one"); with the mutant the sentinel set no longer holds `not-a-junit-report`, the recorded sentinel equals the one the gate computes, and the text reads "seal intact" over a file that is not a report (the json payload differs too). The five other missions identical, `unread` included (the `unreadable` sentinel is still in the set). This is RWD-2026-0189's second sentinel: the fix covers it, the test pins only `unreadable`. METHOD (2026-11-04, report of CI run 41888999672 on main df9ae80, dist/lib/evidence.js byte-identical to the report's embedded source). The mutant was spliced into the built file at its report offsets (written, read back, restored after), and `check --strict --json` and the rendered `check --strict` text (`node dist/cli.js`, Node 24.22.1, NO_COLOR=1) were compared byte for byte (exit code, stdout, stderr) with the pristine build, run twice to rule out nondeterminism, on six fresh `init --example` missions (request-triage, structureContract:true): `nu` (untouched); `carrier` (observability-schema.md Carrier field reads `request_id in logs, events and metrics.` without backticks; pristine exit 1, "names no backticked literal token"); `costeof` (the file cut right after the `## 5. Cost ceilings` heading, no trailing newline; pristine exit 1, "the cost ceilings carry no number"); `costnl` (the same with a trailing newline; pristine exit 1, same message); `notjunit` (frozen, then code/reports/junit.xml, a junit-projection entry, rewritten to `not a report` and its lock entry set to the sentinel `not-a-junit-report`; pristine exit 1, "no longer parses as one"); `unread` (frozen, then code/reports/junit.xml made unreadable with chmod 000, run as a non-root user; pristine exit 1, "sealed evidence changed: code/reports/junit.xml"). Recipe: scratchpad probe.mjs, results.json.
